title: 여기가 내 무대야
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Rock track featuring a male tenor vocal. The arrangement is driven by distorted electric guitar power chords and a bright, compressed acoustic piano playing syncopated rhythmic stabs. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated riff in the background. The bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a punchy snare and consistent eighth-note hi-hat patterns. The production uses modern pop compression and bright EQ on the vocals. Tempo is 128 BPM in the key of E Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, bright acoustic piano stabs]
[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals]
새로고침 누르고 [bass and kick drum enter]
또 새로고침 눌러
3초 차이로 밀려
빈 회의실이 없어
노트북 들고 복도 [clean electric guitar arpeggio enters]
의자도 없는 자리야
형광등이 윙윙
오늘도 여기서 해
[Chorus]
[full band energy increases, crash cymbal]
오 3시의 복도
여긴 내 회의실이야
닫힌 문 저편에선
웃음소리 새어 나와
